value.rationale: The first sharp \(L^2\)-to-\(L^6\) finite-field parabola theorem explicitly excludes characteristic three. Triple-fiber degeneracy at \(s=0\) makes the Hessian a nontrivial arithmetic boundary problem. The exact distinct curvature bands, strictly positive local stability gap, and least-stable phase directions provide a natural quantitative local invariant; global optimality is not falsely asserted.
